title: Synchronize published v0.5.62 projection and finalize release closure
outOfScope: Creating, moving, deleting, or republishing any immutable provider tag or release
Rewriting WI-01 through WI-19 archived evidence
Changes to runtime or product behavior unrelated to release projections and adoption validation
Publishing another release from this Work Item

sources.reason: Provider evidence that v0.5.62 is immutable stable release and public assets are authoritative.
Observed failure showing repository release.json lagged the stable provider release.
Observed adoption validation failure caused by missing explicit Outcome report language.
Release projection, post-publication, and candidate progression contract.
Outcome and human-facing evidence handoff requirements.

riskAssessment.reason: Post-publication source projections are stale and the adoption validator invokes ai-finish without a required explicit report language; both can misstate release or human-facing Outcome facts.

reasons: Published release identity and human-facing Outcome evidence require strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized final release completion and requested evidence-backed self-check loops; no provider mutation is in scope.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record checkpoints before projection edits and final verification to prevent stale release evidence.

acceptance: Provider v0.5.62 release.json and release-digests.json assets are downloaded, hash-verified, and promoted as the published projection; canonical state advances exactly to candidate v0.5.63 without mutating v0.5.62.

release.json, release-state.json, next-release.json, install.sh, version.json, release-digests.json, capability truth, and documentation-alignment projections are mutually consistent and pass release distribution, state, readiness, and preflight checks.
Post-publication distribution validation passes, including adoption lifecycle validation with an explicit REPORT_LANGUAGE value so generated Outcome and human reports are never language-ambiguous.
The human audit and generated Outcome/Task Report list observed failures, resolutions, evidence references, remaining risks, unknowns, and human decisions without unsupported benefit claims.
guidelines: Treat provider v0.5.62 assets as evidence and never overwrite or reuse immutable tags.
Use the canonical projection synchronizer and preserve atomic validation before writes.
Every human-facing Outcome generation command must bind an explicit report language.
Bind release and benefit claims to evidenceRefs; label unsupported benefits as inference.
Do not rewrite historical Work Item archives.

intent.problem: After v0.5.62 was published successfully, the repository still advertised v0.5.61 as release.json and the post-publication checker failed before it could validate adoption because its ai-finish subprocess omitted the required report language.
constraints: Provider v0.5.62 is immutable evidence and must not be moved, deleted, or republished.
Advance the repository candidate exactly one patch to v0.5.63 after synchronizing v0.5.62.
Preserve WI-01 through WI-19 archived records and keep factual human-facing claims evidence-bound.
intent.rationale: A published release must be reflected by the repository's canonical projections, and adoption validation must exercise the same explicit-language Outcome contract required of real agents.

declaredIntent.summary: Promote verified v0.5.62 provider assets into repository projections, advance the next candidate, and make post-publication adoption validation language-safe.

rawUserRequest: Complete the final release and closeout. Continue self-checking until all discovered issues are resolved, keep Outcomes evidence-bound and language-correct, and leave local and remote Work Item state clean.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized the governed self-check loop and its generated preflight decision evidence; no provider mutation is performed by WI-20.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The provider has a stable v0.5.62 release while repository release.json still names v0.5.61.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: Provider assets are hash-verified, release.json becomes v0.5.62, and candidate/state advance exactly to v0.5.63.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the canonical synchronizer and release distribution/state/readiness/preflight checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Post-publication adoption validation invokes ai-finish without REPORT_LANGUAGE.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: The validator supplies an explicit language and completes the adoption check without an ambiguous Outcome.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a regression assertion and run post-publication distribution validation with REPORT_LANGUAGE=en.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Projection synchronization runs after WI-19 closure.
scenarioCoverage.expectedResult: WI-01 through WI-19 archived evidence remains unchanged and only WI-20-owned paths are modified.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run scope/diff ownership checks and compare historical archive paths before and after the Work Item.

rollbackNote: Revert only the WI-20 projection and validator diff; retain immutable provider v0.5.62 and all historical Work Item archives.
